subject: Re: Partner request — Accelerator cohort voucher top-up (CloudBridge)
messages:
From: Saira Patel <saira@cloudbridge.co>
To: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Devon Lee <devon@cloudbridge.co>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner request — Accelerator cohort voucher top-up (CloudBridge)

Hi Neha,

Hope you’re well — quick ask from the CloudBridge accelerator team. We’ve got a surprise expansion for our Q4 cohort (additional 12 early-stage startups onboarding next week). The original trial allocation we were given is going to be exhausted within a few days. Can Redwood provide a short-term promotional top-up (trial credits/voucher) so these teams can complete their POCs?

What we need: a one-time voucher covering ~$7,500 in usage, valid for 30 days, redeemable via the marketplace or a code. I’ve attached a small CSV with company names and expected start dates (cohort_list.csv).

Fast answers would be hugely appreciated — the onboarding kickoff is 10/20 and we want all teams to have a smooth first week. Happy to jump on a brief call if that helps.

Thanks —
Saira Patel
Partnerships Lead, CloudBridge Accelerator
[saira@cloudbridge.co]

Attachment: cohort_list.csv (CSV, 12 rows)
From: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Saira Patel <saira@cloudbridge.co>, Devon Lee <devon@cloudbridge.co>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partner request — Accelerator cohort voucher top-up (CloudBridge)

Thanks Saira — looping in Marissa and Ben to get fast routing. A few clarifying items so we can move this through approvals quickly:

- Confirmed ask: $7,500 promo credit, single-use voucher or marketplace redemption?
- Eligibility: only the 12 listed startups, one voucher per startup, expire 30 days after issuance?
- Do any of these startups already have paid commits with Redwood (so we avoid double-credit)?

Marissa — do you have capacity for a quick sign-off on a $7.5k promo? Ben — if you can pre-check whether finance can issue a marketplace voucher/code this week, that would help. I’ll prepare a brief one-paragraph memo for approval once we have the answers.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Saira Patel <saira@cloudbridge.co>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partner request — Accelerator cohort voucher top-up (CloudBridge)

Neha / Ben — reviewed the cohort list and the ask. Approve a $6,000 promotional allocation (we'll cover 80% of the requested $7.5k) to make this actionable this week. Conditions:

- One voucher per startup; max $500 per startup.
- Voucher valid for 30 days from issuance.
- CloudBridge must include Redwood in their accelerator partner slide and send a short post-pilot usage summary (1 page) within 45 days.

I’ve attached a short approval memo for finance (approval-memo.pdf). If Ben confirms the marketplace routing is possible we should be able to issue codes by EOD tomorrow.

-Marissa
VP, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachment: approval-memo.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Saira Patel <saira@cloudbridge.co>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partner request — Accelerator cohort voucher top-up (CloudBridge)

All — finance has signed off on the $6,000 allocation and I can generate marketplace promo codes. Planned execution:

- Generate 12 promo codes, tiered amounts (8x $500, 4x $250) to total $6,000.
- Codes will be single-use, expire in 30 days.
- I will upload codes to the marketplace and share a redemption spreadsheet + a text file with codes (promo-credit-voucher.txt).
- I’ll create a short invoice entry for internal tracking (HubSpot deal updated).

Saira — please confirm the email addresses we should bind each code to (if you prefer us to leave them open we can, but binding gives better audit). Once confirmed I’ll push the codes and share the link.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

Attachment: promo-credit-voucher.txt (TXT, list of 12 codes)
From: Saira Patel <saira@cloudbridge.co>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partner request — Accelerator cohort voucher top-up (CloudBridge)

Thanks, Ben — appreciate the speed. We’ll bind the codes to the corporate onboarding emails for each startup (list attached in the CSV). I’m adding Devon to coordinate mapping and we'll send the final list by EOD Monday.

Next steps for CloudBridge:
- We’ll return the post-pilot summary within 45 days as requested.
- We’ll include Redwood branding in the partner materials for the cohort kickoff.

Huge help — this makes the onboarding much smoother. I’ll follow up once we have the final email list.

Best,
Saira
